title: CAU CTXT/AE Time-Memory Trade-Off
summary: For CAU's CTXT or AE security, standard analyses do not appear to yield the desired time-memory trade-off, so establishing one remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Can one establish a time--memory trade-off for the $\mathrm{CTXT}$ or $\mathrm{AE}$ security of $\mathrm{CAU}$? The unresolved limitation is that the standard analysis of either security notion does not appear to yield such a trade-off.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption security and time-memory trade-offs for the CAU construction.
parameters: time and memory, the resources whose trade-off is sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establishing a time-memory trade-off for the CTXT or AE security of CAU, since the standard analysis does not appear to yield one.

progress.summary: The paper presents this as a limitation after its nonce-respecting INDR time-memory result for CAU: the standard CTXT/AE analysis does not appear to provide a similar trade-off. It gives CTXT and AE bounds only when CAU is used within the restricted NCH channel construction.
citation_labels: Ashrujit Ghoshal et al., The Memory-Tightness of Authenticated Encryption
